verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a command-line tool, so exit codes and logs are a fair axis to judge. However, the evidence pack never documents its exit codes, error or warning logging, or any structured failure signal. Running in GitHub Actions and reading stdin/stdout are adjacent features that do not show a pipeline can tell success from failure.

support.subject: As a developer, the tool returns meaningful exit codes and logs, so a pipeline can tell success from failure without parsing prose
